title: Illustrative business registry Consultation binding
description: Typed business-public data and Consultation inputs. The root validates Record.data; named definitions bind Record, RecordPage, Lookup and Search.

BusinessData.description: Fixed business-public view containing the registered legal name and domain registration status.

legalName.description: Current legal name recorded by the business registry; no assertion about a person's identity is made.

RegistrationStatus.description: ACTIVE means registered and not dissolved; DISSOLVED means registration has ended. The registry can add statuses; clients handle unrecognised values.

BusinessRecord.description: The shared record envelope bound to the business-public view; additive envelope metadata remains permitted.

allOf.description: Concrete identity and view constraints for this example.

recordId.description: Existing non-personal source identifier. Records are ordered by ascending ASCII bytes of this value, which is also the unique tie-breaker.

BusinessPage.description: A typed business record page; optional total is exact for authorized matching records at evaluation of this page.

allOf.description: Every item uses the same declared business-public view.

items.description: At most the effective pageSize business records, in ascending ASCII recordId order.

RegistrationNumberValues.description: Complete exact key, unique throughout this Registry, matched byte for byte.

registrationNumber.description: Registry-assigned registration number, including the uppercase prefix and all six digits.

JurisdictionNumberValues.description: Composite exact key whose pair is unique in this Registry. Both fields are matched byte for byte.

jurisdictionCode.description: Two-letter registry-owned jurisdiction code, not asserted to be an ISO country code.

localNumber.description: Eight-digit identifier within the jurisdiction; leading zeroes are significant.

BusinessLookupRequest.description: One of two typed exact-key selectors. Selector names determine their complete accepted key fields.

selector.description: Published exact selector name, constrained together with its values by oneOf.

values.description: The complete typed key associated with the chosen selector.

RegistrationStatusCriteria.description: One equality predicate over the declared business registration status, with no implicit case conversion.

FieldEqualityCriteria.description: Equality predicates over any non-empty combination of the declared business-public fields. Every supplied field must match exactly; omitted fields do not constrain the result.

BusinessSearchRequest.description: One of two typed equality searches with continuation controls. Search names determine their accepted criteria. Repeat search and criteria on continuation.

search.description: Published search name, constrained together with its criteria by oneOf.

criteria.description: The typed criteria associated with the chosen search.

oneOf.description: Equality search over the declared business-public fields.
